scene.ko: 다음 주 면접 때문에 긴장된다고 친구에게 털어놓고 격려를 받는다.

lines.en: You seem a little quiet today. Is something on your mind?
lines.ko: 오늘 좀 조용하네요. 무슨 고민 있어요?

lines.en: Yeah, I'm kind of stressed. I have a job interview on Monday.
lines.ko: 네, 좀 스트레스받아요. 월요일에 면접이 있거든요.
alt: I guess I'm a bit stressed. I've got a job interview on Monday.
Yeah. I'm nervous about a job interview on Monday.

lines.en: Oh, that's exciting, though! Is it a job you really want?
lines.ko: 와, 그래도 좋은 일이잖아요! 정말 가고 싶은 곳이에요?

lines.en: It is. That's the problem. I keep worrying that I'll freeze up and forget everything.
lines.ko: 네. 그래서 더 문제예요. 긴장해서 머리가 하얘지고 다 까먹을까 봐 계속 걱정돼요.
alt: Yes, and that's why I'm so nervous. I'm afraid I'll freeze up and forget what to say.

lines.en: That's totally normal. Everyone feels that way before a big interview.
lines.ko: 완전히 정상이에요. 중요한 면접 전엔 누구나 그래요.

lines.en: Really? But you always seem so confident.
lines.ko: 정말요? 그래도 늘 자신감 있어 보이던데요.
alt: You think so? You always look so confident, though.

lines.en: Ha! Trust me, I'm a nervous wreck before interviews. Want to do a practice run this weekend?
lines.ko: 하하! 진짜예요, 저도 면접 전엔 완전 떨어요. 이번 주말에 연습 한번 해 볼래요?

lines.en: That would really help. Thanks for listening. I feel better already.
lines.ko: 그러면 정말 도움이 되겠어요. 들어 줘서 고마워요. 벌써 마음이 좀 나아졌어요.
alt: That would be great. Thanks for listening. I already feel a little better.

expressions.note: kind of = 좀, 약간 · 감정을 부드럽게 말할 때
